_comment: Pinned Vega-Lite renderer stack for the paint harness (ADR-0003 Decision 5, issue #126). Each file is the UMD `build/*.min.js` from the named npm tarball, vendored verbatim and never fetched at run time. Bump by re-running `npm pack <name>@<version>`, copying the UMD build here, and recomputing sha256 — never by hand-editing the digest.
